mapper.select: SELECT T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID, T1.TRADE_DATE, T1.PS, T1.VDATE, T1.MDATE, T1.SETTLE_SPEED, T1.DELIVERY_TYPE, T1.CLEAR_TYPE, T1.EFF_TIME, T1.REMARK, T1.CCY, fin_product.finprod_id finprodId, fin_product.finprod_abbr finprodName, T1.unit_cprice unitCprice, T1.unit_fprice unitFprice, t1.cprice_amt, t1.fprice_amt, t1.int_amt, T1.unit_int unitInt, T1.yield *100 yield, T1.exer_yield*100 exerYield, T1.share_amt*100 shareAmt, T1.TRADER, T1.COUNTER_ID, T1.COUNTER_TRADER, T1.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, T3.ENTRUST_ID, T3.PORTFOLIO_ID, T2.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID secManageId, t2.share_amt * 100 trade_amt, t2.fprice_amt fpriceAmt, t2.cprice_amt cpriceAmt, t2.int_amt tradeAmount, t3.reg_date_amt do_entrust_money FROM TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL T1 LEFT JOIN fin_product ON T1.finprod_id = fin_product.finprod_id AND T1.finprod_type2 = fin_product.finprod_type2 LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_PRE T2 ON T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = T2.TOTLE_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD_PRE T3 ON T2.TRADE_ID = T3.TRADE_ID WHERE T1.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = #{tradeId}

select ACCT_NAME id, BUSI_ACCT_NO text, BUSI_ACCT_NO, CCY, ACCT_NO, ACCT_NAME, BANK_DEP, IN_OUT_BANK, CORR_NO, LARGE_PAYNO, SWIFT_CODE,
BLN_AREA, IS_OVERDRAW, REMARK, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME,SEQ_NO /* add by songyawei 2020-06-18 */ from STL_CAPACCT_INFO
( BUSI_ACCT_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) or ACCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND BUSI_ACCT_NO = #{initValue}
order by BUSI_ACCT_NO desc
